message: `texture.white` is a CPU-only built-in function, but the fragment stage of material 'Gloss' runs on the GPU.

related.message: the fragment stage of material 'Gloss' runs on the GPU

notes: help: textures and samplers are made outside the stage: declare them as params of the material with their default (`param tex: texture = texture.white();`, `param smp: sampler = sampler.linear_repeat();`, or `asset.texture("file.png")`) and write `sample(tex, smp, uv)` in the stage
